messages:
Priya (oncall): Noticed a recurring latency cluster on reranker during last night's traffic surge around 02:45 UTC. p95 and throughput both degraded ~15m. Creating thread to align on SLO handling and owners.

Marco: Traces show reranker workers hit GC spikes when large batched requests hit the queue. Looks like payload-size correlation.

Ellen: If it's batch-size related we should avoid blanket SLO relaxations. Propose: short-term SLO window for affected route only (/v1/rerank) for 24h, plus ingress soft-throttle for large batches. Exclude the window from monthly error-budget calculation.

Priya (oncall): Agreed. Who can own the throttle and dashboard work?

Samir: I can push a soft ingress throttle (limit payloads >1MB with burst 4) and add a payload-size panel. ETA: 4h. I'll also add a metric to the runbook.

Marco: I'll take autoscale tuning on the reranker pool (lower CPU target to 55%, add 45s cooldown). ETA: EOD.

Ellen: I'll handle SLO comms and the status page blurb. Draft: "Temporary p95 increase for /v1/rerank to 700ms for 24h due to GC pressure from large batch requests; Dedicated customers may opt-out." ETA: 1.5h.

Priya (oncall): Ops-Bot, create a parent ticket and subtasks for throttle (Samir), autoscale (Marco), SLO comms (Ellen), and dashboard panel (Samir). Schedule 24h check-in.

Ops-Bot: Created REDW-4207 with subtasks REDW-4208 -> Samir (ingress throttle + panels), REDW-4209 -> Marco (autoscale), REDW-4210 -> Ellen (SLO comms). Reminder set for 2950086600 (24h).

Samir: Throttle applied to canary; observing reduced GC incidence. Will roll after stable window.

Ellen: Status page posted and dashboard annotated: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/REDW-4207

Marco: Autoscale tweak deployed to canary. Monitoring p95.

Priya (oncall): We'll attach this thread to the postmortem and mark these owners in the action tracker. Closing thread for async follow-up ":thumbsup:"
